summary: OpenRouter lists NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL as a free endpoint (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free), served by NVIDIA, priced at $0 for prompt and completion tokens with a 1,000,000-token context. NVIDIA describes it as an open multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 12B active of 120B total parameters that accepts text, images, documents, GUI screenshots and video. The endpoint was created 2026-10-15; no end date is published. The free endpoint and generated content are for internal testing/evaluation only, not production, under the linked NVIDIA API Trial Terms sections 1.2 and 1.4; production requires a separate subscription and its terms. Do not submit confidential information or personal data, including voices or faces. Use is logged for security and NVIDIA product/service improvement, with improvement-session data not linked to persistent identifiers. Public provider metadata is not a completed inference test; check current provider health before use.
claim_steps: Create an OpenRouter account and API key; OpenRouter free-model rate limits apply.

Use the free API service and generated content only for internal testing/evaluation, not production, under NVIDIA API Trial Terms sections 1.2 and 1.4. Production requires a separate subscription and its terms.

Review the model-page notice and NVIDIA API Trial Terms. Never send confidential information or personal data, including voices or faces; use is logged for security and NVIDIA product/service improvement.
Check current provider health before calling chat completions with model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl:free. Public endpoint status/uptime is not a completed inference test.
